title: Gateway model listing: only named endpoints, sorted by name, ids are endpoint names
answers: what model IDs does the gateway models endpoint return?
why does an unnamed gateway endpoint not appear in the OpenAI models list?
what is the created timestamp unit in the gateway models response?
how do OpenAI clients pick a gateway endpoint name as model
body:
Invariant: the OpenAI-compatible model list is built from store.list_gateway_endpoints(), keeping only endpoints with a non-empty name, sorted by name, with id=endpoint.name and owned_by="mlflow".
Enforced by mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:list_models. Endpoints without a name are filtered out, since the name is the value clients pass as the chat completions model parameter.
created is endpoint.created_at // 1000 (epoch milliseconds converted to seconds, as the OpenAI models schema expects).
Skipping the name filter would emit null or empty model ids that cannot be used with /gateway/mlflow/v1/chat/completions.
applies: Changes to the response shape or ordering of /gateway/mlflow/v1/models in mlflow/server/gateway_api.py; schema types live in mlflow/gateway/schemas/models.py.
says: Gateway endpoints without names do not appear in the model selection list.
Sort the available AI Gateway models alphabetically by name.
Unnamed gateway endpoints are missing from the OpenAI-compatible model dropdown.
Model creation timestamps in the gateway list should be displayed in seconds.
Allow clients to discover and select gateway endpoints by their configured name.
search: In mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:list_models, the OpenAI-compatible model list includes only endpoints from store.list_gateway_endpoints() having non-empty names, sorted by name with id=endpoint.name and owned_by='mlflow'. Unnamed endpoints are filtered out because clients supply the endpoint name as the model parameter in /gateway/mlflow/v1/chat/completions. The created timestamp converts endpoint.created_at from epoch milliseconds to seconds via integer division by 1000 per mlflow/gateway/schemas/models.py:ModelObject. Applies to changes affecting the response shape or ordering of /gateway/mlflow/v1/models.
